failed calls by gRPC code:
inv.v1.Inv/Oversized codes set by the client: ResourceExhausted 10

The "request error" rows are calls that fail the same way at any rate. Either
the request is wrong - no such method, a bad argument, a body that does not match
the schema - or
a request refused as larger than accepted, by the target or a proxy in front of it.
Check the config for inv.v1.Inv/Rejected, inv.v1.Inv/Mixed.

invalid run: every measured call of inv.v1.Inv/Rejected came back as a request that will not
be served, by the target or a proxy in front of it. Nothing about the load was
tested there; fix the request and run again.

invalid run: the client could not send any call of inv.v1.Inv/ClientError: the request did not
encode, or the client's own stack refused it; see the codes set by the client.
Nothing reached the target.

invalid run: every response of inv.v1.Inv/Oversized was larger than max_response_size (4MB):
raise it.

invalid run: responses of inv.v1.Inv/Compressed came compressed with an encoding the client does
not accept. gRPC lets a server compress only with an encoding the client
announced in grpc-accept-encoding: the target or a proxy in front of it breaks that.

invalid run: every measured call of inv.v1.Inv/Mixed failed the same way at any rate:
request error 4, client error 3, bad response 3. Nothing about the load was
tested there.

A method's percentiles are the time to serve a call: successes, and timeouts
as lower bounds. The rows under it time the other answers:
"bad response": a reply came and the client did not accept it.
